title: Hotplug drain loop does not distinguish CKR_NO_EVENT from CKR_GENERAL_ERROR
description: test_hotplug_queue_overflow drains the ring with 'while (rv == CKR_OK) { C_WaitForSlotEvent }' then checks 'rv == CKR_NO_EVENT'. If C_WaitForSlotEvent returns CKR_GENERAL_ERROR (e.g. mutex lock failure in a stressed test environment), the loop exits but the check fails — the test reports FAIL rather than PASS or SKIP. This is not a silent pass, so the risk is a spurious failure rather than a missed bug. Fix: explicit check for the two expected loop-exit values (CKR_OK and CKR_NO_EVENT) with a dedicated assertion; anything else is a test infrastructure error.
